repos.description: 我的电视 电视直播软件，安装即可使用
repos.summary_zh: 我的电视是一款专为智能电视和盒子设计的直播软件，支持U盘安装、ADB部署及小米电视助手安装，提供即装即用的电视直播服务。具备频道收藏、多平台适配等基础功能，适用于Android设备，但部分老旧机型存在兼容性问题。
repos.summary_en: My TV is a ready-to-use live streaming app for smart TVs and Android boxes, supporting USB installation, ADB deployment, and Mi TV Assistant. It offers basic features like channel favorites and multi-platform compatibility, though some legacy devices may face instability or incompatibility issues.

repos.description: 首家工业级全流程 AI 影视生产平台。Industry-first professional AI Agent platform for controllable film & video production. From shorts to live-action with Hollywood-standard workflows.
repos.summary_zh: waoowaoo AI影视工作室是一款工业级全流程AI短剧/漫画视频制作工具，支持从小说文本自动生成分镜、角色和场景，并合成完整视频。具备AI剧本分析、角色场景生成、分镜视频制作及多角色AI配音功能，提供好莱坞标准工作流，支持中英文界面切换，采用Next.js+React技术栈与Docker化部署。
repos.summary_en: waoowaoo is an industrial-grade AI-powered short drama/comic video production platform that automatically generates storyboards, characters, and scenes from novel text, then synthesizes them into complete videos. Features include AI script analysis, character/scene generation, shot-by-shot video creation, multi-role AI voice synthesis, and Hollywood-standard workflows with bilingual support and Docker-based deployment using Next.js + React.

repos.description: 首家工业级全流程 AI 影视生产平台。Industry-first professional AI Agent platform for controllable film & video production. From shorts to live-action with Hollywood-standard workflows.
repos.summary_zh: waoowaoo 是全球首家工业级全流程 AI 影视生产平台，支持从小说文本自动生成分镜、角色、场景并合成完整视频。具备 AI 剧本分析、角色场景生成、分镜视频制作、AI 多角色配音及双语界面等核心功能，采用 Next.js 15 + Docker 架构，提供好莱坞标准工作流，适用于短剧与漫画视频创作。
repos.summary_en: waoowaoo is the world's first industrial-grade AI-powered film and video production platform, enabling end-to-end creation from novel text to final video with storyboard generation, character/scene synthesis, and multi-character voiceover. Built on Next.js 15 and Docker, it offers Hollywood-standard workflows for short dramas and comic videos, featuring bilingual UI and seamless API integration.

repos.description: 本项目采用 CC BY-NC-SA 协议，禁止任何商业化行为，任何衍生项目必须保留本项目地址并以相同协议开源
repos.summary_zh: MoonTV 是一款基于 Next.js 14 + TypeScript + Tailwind CSS 构建的跨平台影视聚合播放器，支持多源搜索、在线 HLS 播放、收藏同步及 PWA 离线缓存。采用 Kvrocks/Redis 存储播放进度，集成 ArtPlayer 与 HLS.js 实现流畅播放体验，支持响应式设计与智能去广告功能。
repos.summary_en: MoonTV is a cross-platform video aggregation player built with Next.js 14, TypeScript, and Tailwind CSS. It supports multi-source search, HLS streaming via ArtPlayer/HLS.js, cloud-synced watchlist, and PWA offline caching. Uses Kvrocks/Redis for playback progress storage with responsive UI and experimental ad-blocking.

repos.description: 首家工业级全流程 AI 影视生产平台。Industry-first professional AI Agent platform for controllable film & video production. From shorts to live-action with Hollywood-standard workflows.
repos.summary_zh: waoowaoo AI 影视 Studio 是首家工业级全流程可控协作式专业 AI 智能体影视生产平台，支持从小说文本自动生成分镜、角色、场景并制作成完整视频，涵盖短片到漫剧再到真人级影视剧的全流程制作，采用好莱坞专业制作团队思路，提供虚拟制片场体验。
repos.summary_en: waoowaoo AI Studio is the first industrial-grade, end-to-end controllable collaborative AI agent platform for professional film and TV production, supporting full-process creation from short films to anime series and feature films. It automatically generates storyboards, characters, and scenes from novel text and assembles them into complete videos, following Hollywood-level production workflows.

repos.description: FongMi影视和tvbox配置文件，如果喜欢，请Fork自用。使用前请仔细阅读仓库说明，一旦使用将被视为你已了解。
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供FongMi影视、TVBox及猫影视的多种配置文件（如0707.json、0821.json等），集成多线路直播、自动换源、点播解析等功能，支持主流TVBox应用。资源源自社区大神分享，包含第三方配置源与随机壁纸API，适用于家庭影院系统搭建，仅供个人学习研究使用。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers multiple configuration files for FongMi影视, TVBox, and CatVod platforms (e.g., 0707.json, 0821.json), supporting multi-line live streaming, automatic source switching, and video playback parsing. It integrates community-sourced third-party APIs and random wallpaper services, designed for home theater setups. Intended strictly for personal learning and research use.

repos.description: AI 影视生产级工具 | 支持 Seedance 2.0 | 剧本到成片全流程批量化 | AI-powered film production tool with Seedance 2.0 support
repos.summary_zh: 魔因漫创是一款AI影视生产级工具，支持Seedance 2.0多模态生成，实现从剧本解析、角色场景生成到分镜制作与成片输出的全流程自动化。具备角色一致性管理、批量化生产队列、多供应商AI调度等核心能力，专为短剧、动漫番剧等中高频内容创作场景设计。
repos.summary_en: Moyin Creator is an AI-powered film production tool supporting Seedance 2.0 for end-to-end automation from script parsing to final video generation. It features character consistency, batch processing, and multi-provider AI scheduling, optimized for short-form dramas and anime series.

repos.description: Multi-Platform Live Stream Automatic Recording Tool | 多平台直播流自动录制客户端 · 基于FFmpeg · 支持监控/定时/转码
repos.summary_zh: StreamCap 是一款基于 FFmpeg 的多平台直播流自动录制工具，支持 40+ 国内外主流直播平台（如抖音、B站、Twitch、TikTok），具备循环监控、定时录制、批量任务管理和自动转码功能，提供 Windows/macOS/Linux/Web 全平台支持，适用于内容存档与直播数据分析。
repos.summary_en: StreamCap is a multi-platform live stream recording tool powered by FFmpeg and StreamGet, supporting 40+ global platforms (e.g., Douyin, Bilibili, Twitch, TikTok). It features real-time monitoring, scheduled recording, batch processing, and automatic transcoding, with full support for Windows, macOS, Linux, and web deployment for content archiving and live data analysis.

repos.description: AI资讯日报 是一个基于 Cloudflare Workers 驱动的内容聚合与生成平台。它每日为您精选 AI 领域的最新动态，包括行业新闻、热门开源项目、前沿学术论文、科技大V社交媒体言论，并通过 Google Gemini 模型进行智能处理与摘要生成，最终自动发布到 GitHub Pages 生成 AI 日报。
repos.summary_zh: AI资讯日报是基于Cloudflare Workers构建的自动化内容聚合平台，每日精选AI领域新闻、开源项目与学术论文，通过Google Gemini生成智能摘要并发布至GitHub Pages。支持Folo订阅源接入，提供网页、RSS及微信公众号多端阅读体验，兼具技术学习价值与个人定制潜力。
repos.summary_en: AI Insight Daily is an automated content aggregation platform built on Cloudflare Workers. It curates daily AI news, open-source projects, and research papers, generating intelligent summaries via Google Gemini and publishing them to GitHub Pages. Supports Folo RSS feeds, offering multi-platform access via web, RSS, and WeChat Official Account, serving as both a learning resource and customizable tool.

repos.description: TVBox自用接口
repos.summary_zh: TVBox自用接口集合，提供多地域GitHub RAW加速服务与EPG电子节目指南源，支持直播源搜索及短链生成工具，适用于个人电视盒子流媒体播放场景，强调隐私与自用属性。
repos.summary_en: A personal-use TVBox interface repository offering multi-region GitHub RAW acceleration, EPG sources for electronic program guides, live stream search tools, and URL shortening services, designed for private streaming on media boxes without public promotion.

repos.summary_zh: LunaTV Enhanced Edition 是基于 MoonTV 深度二次开发的全功能影视聚合播放平台，集成 YouTube、网盘搜索、AI推荐、短剧、IPTV直播、Bangumi动漫等60+重大功能增强。采用 Next.js + React + TypeScript 技术栈，支持 Docker 部署，具备弹幕系统、播放统计、Emby私有库集成、超宽显示器适配等特性，提供极致在线观影体验。
repos.summary_en: LunaTV Enhanced Edition is a comprehensive media aggregation platform based on MoonTV with 60+ major feature enhancements including YouTube integration, cloud drive search, AI recommendations, short dramas, IPTV streaming, and Bangumi anime. Built with Next.js, React, and TypeScript, featuring Docker deployment, danmaku system, playback statistics, Emby private library integration, and ultra-wide display support for an ultimate online viewing experience.

repos.description: 直播源检索、测速、优选
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供高效电视直播源检索、测速与优选工具，基于FFmpeg实现多维度视频流质量检测（卡顿、延迟、丢帧等），自动筛选高速稳定源并生成订阅链接。支持本地网络环境适配，每日自动更新，优化高清源加载体验，适用于安卓直播软件壳配置使用。
repos.summary_en: This repository delivers a high-efficiency TV live stream retrieval, speed testing, and optimization tool. It uses FFmpeg for multi-dimensional quality checks (lag, buffering, frame drops) to automatically select fast and stable streams, generating subscription links. Supports local network adaptation, daily updates, and optimized HD loading, ideal for Android live-streaming apps.

repos.description: tvbox 影视tv 宝盒 接口
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库提供多个TVBox影视接口配置，包括自用、Panda Groove、多线路及香雅情等源，支持阿里Token推送功能，适用于电视盒子应用。所有接口均通过镜像加速访问，内容涵盖主流影视资源聚合，便于用户快速部署个性化影视播放平台。
repos.summary_en: This repository offers multiple TVBox streaming interfaces, including self-hosted, Panda Groove, multi-line, and Xiangyaqing sources, with support for Aliyun Token push. It is designed for TV box applications, providing mirrored access to mainstream video aggregation services for quick deployment of custom streaming platforms.

repos.description: 强大的ai小说创作网站
repos.summary_zh: Ai-Novel 是一个功能强大的 AI 小说创作平台，支持多 LLM 提供商（OpenAI、Claude、Gemini），提供流式写作、知识库管理、RAG 检索、图谱分析等核心能力。采用 React + FastAPI 架构，支持 Docker Compose 一键部署，具备项目管理、角色设定、大纲生成、批量任务及导出等功能，适用于专业作家与内容创作者。
repos.summary_en: Ai-Novel is a powerful AI-powered novel writing platform supporting multiple LLM providers (OpenAI, Claude, Gemini) with features like streaming generation, knowledge base management, RAG retrieval, and graph analysis. Built on React + FastAPI, it offers project management, character development, outline generation, batch tasks, and export capabilities via Docker Compose deployment.

repos.description: A webServer convert web and x5 movie sites to cms api data
repos.summary_zh: dr_py 是一个将主流影视网站（含x5内核站点）转换为 CMS API 数据源的 Python 服务器，专为 TV Box 和 Pluto 等应用设计。它基于 dr 模板重构，提供标准化接口，支持多平台部署与自动嗅探，适用于无需编程知识的内容聚合场景。
repos.summary_en: dr_py is a Python-based web server that converts web and x5 movie sites into CMS-compatible API data, tailored for TV Box and Pluto apps. It reimplements the dr template with standardized interfaces, supports cross-platform deployment, and enables automatic content sniffing without requiring Java knowledge.

repos.description: 参考Spec-kit 实现小说撰写工具
repos.summary_zh: Novel Writer 是基于规格驱动开发（SDD）的 AI 智能中文小说创作工具，支持在 Claude、Cursor、Gemini 等 13 个 AI 助手中通过斜杠命令系统化创作。提供七步创作方法论、情节追踪、角色一致性验证等核心功能，专为中文小说写作优化，支持跨平台使用与插件扩展。
repos.summary_en: Novel Writer is an AI-driven Chinese novel writing tool based on Specification-Driven Development (SDD), enabling systematic creation through slash commands in 13 AI assistants like Claude, Cursor, and Gemini. It offers a 7-step methodology, plot tracking, character consistency checks, and Chinese-optimized features, with cross-platform support and extensible plugin architecture.

repos.description: OpenAI 接口聚合管理，我们致力于提供优质的API接入服务，让您可以轻松集成先进的AI模型至您的产品和服务。
repos.summary_zh: Chat API 是基于 One API 和 New API 二次开发的 OpenAI 接口聚合管理系统，提供多模型接入、令牌分组计费、渠道标签化管理及 WxPusher 推送通知等功能，支持 Docker/宝塔一键部署，适用于企业级 AI 服务集成。
repos.summary_en: Chat API is a secondary development of One API and New API, serving as an OpenAI interface aggregation management system. It offers multi-model access, token-based billing, channel tagging, WxPusher notifications, and supports Docker/Baota one-click deployment for enterprise-level AI service integration.

repos.summary_zh: bestK/tv 是一个基于 Next.js 的现代化电视直播应用，支持多源直播流聚合、频道分类与搜索功能，提供响应式界面与 EdgeOne Pages 一键部署，适用于构建个人或社区级 IPTV 平台。
repos.summary_en: bestK/tv is a modern TV streaming app built with Next.js, featuring multi-source live stream aggregation, channel categorization, and search functionality. It offers a responsive interface and one-click deployment via EdgeOne Pages, ideal for building personal or community IPTV platforms.

repos.description: 月饼TV
repos.summary_zh: MoonCakeTV 是一个基于 Next.js 15 和 TypeScript 的影视聚合搜索服务，支持多源聚合搜索（苹果CMS v10协议）、HLS.js 在线播放、收藏与历史记录、响应式深色主题及可选密码保护，数据持久化存储无需数据库，支持一键 Docker 部署与 HTTPS 自动配置。
repos.summary_en: MoonCakeTV is a simple yet powerful video aggregation and search service built with Next.js 15 and TypeScript. It supports multi-source search via AppleCMS v10 protocol, HLS.js streaming, favorites, watch history, responsive dark mode, optional password protection, and stores data without a database. Features one-click Docker deployment with automatic HTTPS via Caddy.

repos.description: 用于整合影视仓/tvbox本地包，提高访问速度
repos.summary_zh: My TVBox 是一个手动维护的影视仓/tvbox本地资源整合项目，通过自建服务器提供加速访问的JSON接口，显著提升影视资源加载速度，支持免费使用与持续更新，适用于家庭影院和在线观影场景。
repos.summary_en: My TVBox is a manually maintained project that integrates multiple local TVBox/影视仓 resource lines via a self-hosted server, delivering accelerated JSON API access to improve streaming performance. It offers free, regularly updated resources optimized for smooth viewing experiences.

repos.description: tvbox自动整理
repos.summary_zh: tvbox自动整理是一个用于TVBox流媒体资源自动分类与管理的工具，支持多仓库和单仓库配置，提供JSON格式的资源索引文件，便于用户快速获取并整合影视、直播等视频内容。
repos.summary_en: Tvbox自动整理 is a tool for automated organization of TVBox streaming resources, supporting multi-repo and single-repo configurations with JSON-based index files to streamline access to video content like movies and live streams.

repos.summary_zh: 本项目提供经过筛选的高质量影视接口，包含单仓优选和多仓聚合方案，支持主流网盘下载TVBox及宝盒等第三方影视应用。所有接口内容均来自网络公开资源，仅供自用测试，强调版权合规与来源标注要求。
repos.summary_en: This project offers high-quality streaming interfaces, including single-source optimized and multi-source aggregated APIs, supporting downloads of TVBox and third-party apps via mainstream cloud storage. All content is sourced from public networks for personal use only, with strict copyright compliance and attribution requirements.

repos.description: 使用 Gemini (Nano Banano 和 Veo) 的短视频和漫画创作工具
repos.summary_zh: 基于 Gemini Nano Banano 和 VEO 的短视频与漫画创作工具，支持剧本导入、AI 生成分镜图/视频、角色一致性管理及画布视图，提供完整的内容创作工作流，适用于自媒体、IP 孵化等场景。
repos.summary_en: A video and comic creation tool powered by Gemini (Nano Banano and VEO), featuring script import, AI-generated storyboards/videos, character consistency management, and canvas view, enabling end-to-end content production for creators and IP developers.

repos.summary_zh: TVBOX 是一个专为个人使用的电视盒子应用，提供丰富的影视资源聚合与播放功能，支持多源切换、高清流畅播放及自定义配置，适用于家庭娱乐场景。
repos.summary_en: TVBOX is a personal-use TV box application that aggregates and plays rich video content from multiple sources, supporting high-definition streaming, source switching, and custom configurations for home entertainment.
